Three merged pull requests since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `encounterProviders` under `packages/esm-service-queues-app`, best first:

1. **#2600**, "(feat) O3-5763: Unify the Current visit and Previous visit views", merged **2026-08-28** (10:42 UTC). It removed `encounterProviders` lines from `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/past-visit/past-visit.resource.ts` (the custom representation) and deleted `src/past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx`, which read `encounter.encounterProviders`. It also removed an `encounterProviders` fixture from `src/past-visit/past-visit.test.tsx`. It added the `visitCustomRepresentation` line containing `encounterProviders` in `src/constants.ts:24`.
2. **#2824**, "(feat) O3-6098: Show today's appointments and visit attribute tags in the current visit summary", merged **2026-10-14** (13:55 UTC). It changed the `visitCustomRepresentation` line in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/constants.ts:24`, which contains `encounterProviders`, by altering its `attributes` part.
3. **#2541**, "(fix) O3-5679: De-duplicate patient notes in previous visit tab", merged **2026-06-08** (09:58 UTC). It changed `encounterProviders` lines in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx` (the note and medication provider lookups) and added an `encounterProviders` fixture to `src/past-visit/past-visit.test.tsx`.

Merge dates come from the pull-request records (`mergedAt`), which match the merge-commit dates on main.

Limits of this check:
- I did not diff all 95 commits that touch the app since the cutoff. I identified candidates from the commit list, then checked the diffs of the relevant ones and the net diff of `constants.ts` and `service-queues.resource.ts`.
- The `ref` argument of grep did not return results, so I could not list every file that contained `encounterProviders` at the start of the window.
- Commit 38a1239 (O3-6020, "Change visit summary in queues app to pass in correct encounter object") is a direct commit with no pull request, so it is excluded. Its ticket is O3-6020 if you want it listed.
